book.name: Maliku
book.title: Saaka wù joŋe kune Jiso no Maliku gɛ̀ Saŋ

content: Bamii chu ntaŋ ki bo koo Jiso bo yuuyɛ

Gɛ̀ shɛge aju afaa mo nyume Ŋka wu Ndaŋfe mo Ŋka wu Blɛd wù ba baaŋ gɛɛ gɛ kinshilɛ yo gɛ. Bachiji kintanyɛ ba baaŋ baaŋ mo bamii ba duunyi banchi ba Nyo mo bo goone je yì bo koo Jiso yu nyilɛ le, bo yuuyɛ.
Bo chu ntaŋ lɛbolɛbo lɛ, “Keefɛ besabɛŋ moŋ fiɛɛ finɛ kife kì ba gee Ŋka le gɛ, nje besabɛŋ moŋ lo, fi to bɛ jwe a bamii ntɛnɛɛ.”
Kwɛse wumu yefɛ Jiso bɛ mɛɛ mà gwee wuŋ
Jiso gɛ̀ bee ntɛ wù Bɛtani le, a Samoŋ yeh wù gɛ̀ shɛɛ wù nyu muh goŋ yì baaŋ, bo shii bo jii mwɛɛ, kwɛse wumu ja wu lee bɛ fikaaŋ
fi mɛɛ mà gwee wuŋ. Mɛɛ mayu gɛ̀ tɛɛme kwa, ba kɛnyi bɛ nad lɛwulɛwu. No wu leese, wu mo wu gwenyɛ jwe wu fikaaŋ fiyu wu fuushɛ mɛɛ mayu yi kikwɛɛ ki Jiso le.
Bamii bamu ja bo tu bo shuŋshi lɛbolɛbo bo duu lɛ, “Wu chɛŋe bɛ mɛɛ mayu nɛ nje la?
Ba taŋlo ba gesɛ mɛɛ mayu fe bige banchvuge gii yitɛde, ba nya bige biyu bamii ba kifufe le.” Bo tu bo ŋase lo bɛ wu.
Geenɛ, Jiso jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ chînɛ wu le. Bɛŋ nyaa ŋgɛ wu le nɛ nje la? Wu le wu ge nyu fiɛɛ fì joŋe fɛ mɛne.
Bɛŋ kêe lɛ bamii ba fuude lé bo gê bo nyûme bɛ bɛŋ segechii. Bɛŋ taŋlo bɛŋ fiih bo sege bɛŋ koŋe. Geenɛ, gɛ mɛ nyu ŋge nyume besabɛŋ segechii gɛ.
Kwɛse wunɛ le wu ge nyu fiɛɛ fì taŋlo wu ge. Wu yefɛ mɛ bɛ mɛɛ manɛ nɛ nyu wu seese nyu ye yaŋ baaŋ lo no ba lé ba gê ba jîiyɛ mɛ.
Nsɛŋe bɛŋ nchiɛɛŋ lɛ, mo nyu faaŋ fɛ ba lé ba gê ba fêeji saaka wù joŋe wunɛ yi kikwɛɛ ki nshɛŋ le kichii, fiɛɛ fì kwɛse wunɛ ge ba lé ba sɛ̂ŋe tɛ, ki ba kwaji wu.”

content: Juda gɛɛŋ ki wu gêsɛ Jiso
Juda Ɛkaliot wù gɛ̀ bee muh a ŋgoo yi booŋ ba ŋgoo ba Jiso ba yuufe ncho bafɛɛ le, mo wu ja wu gɛɛŋ fɛ bachiji kintanyɛ ba baaŋ baaŋ le lɛ wu gesɛ Jiso bo le.
Bo doo bo yu noo bo yu njoŋ baaŋ, bo mo bo ka lɛ bo lé bo nyâ wu bige. Wu mo wu kɛ wu goone je yì wu lé wu nyâ Jiso chiaaŋ yiboo le.
Jiso bɛ booŋ be ji mwɛɛ mù fɛkimɛsɛ

Juu chì fwe chi Ŋka wu Blɛd wù ba baaŋ gɛɛ gɛ kinshilɛ yo gɛ, gɛ̀ to chi kojɛ chì bo to bo sɛɛyi mwa kiya wu Ŋka wu Ndaŋfe, booŋ ba Jiso ba ŋgoo biih wu le lɛ, “Wo goone lɛ bee gɛɛŋ bee seesɛ nyu faaŋ fɛ wo lé wo jî Ŋka wu Ndaŋfe fo?”
Wu mo wu tuŋ booŋ be ba ŋgoo bamu bafɛɛ, wu jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ gɛ̂ɛŋ alaantɛŋ, bɛŋ doo bɛŋ gɛɛne, bɛŋ yɛ̂ŋ muh le wu tuu joo a shaaŋ le, bɛŋ bi wu le.

Sege wu gɛɛŋ wu lee yeh yì wu le wu lee yu, bɛŋ jɛ̂mɛ muh wù kɛme yeh yiyu le lɛ, Muh wu N'yɛyɛ biide laa kibuu ki yeh yi bamii ba njiɛnyɛ kɛɛ kì bɛ booŋ be ba ŋgoo lé bo jî Ŋka wu Ndaŋfe yu le faane la?
Wu lé wu dûnyɛ kibuu ki yeh ki awe ba nyu ba seesɛ wa ba kɛnyɛ, bɛŋ mo bɛŋ seesɛ mwɛɛ munjile yu.”

content: Booŋ ba ŋgoo bayu mo bo ja bo gɛɛŋ a kilaantɛŋ kiyu le, bo gɛɛŋ bo yɛŋ mwɛɛ nyu gɛh yɛɛŋyɛɛŋ no Jiso gɛ̀ jɛme bo le. Bo mo bo seesɛ mwɛɛ munjile mu Ŋka wu Ndaŋfe wuyu fo.
Lɛ to nyume fɛnfu, Jiso bɛ booŋ be ba ŋgoo ba yuufe ncho bafɛɛ taashɛ yu.
Bo shii bo tu bo jii mwɛɛ, Jiso ja wu jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Nsɛŋe bɛŋ nchiɛɛŋ lɛ muh mu bɛŋ le, lé wu gê wu gêsɛ mɛ, muh wunɛ jii mwɛɛ besa wu.”

content: Bo yu noo, bo ja bo tu bo nyume yii yii, bo jɛme wu le, wu mumwaa wu mumwaa lɛ, “Le mɛ?”
Wu chvuu lɛ,

content.text: “Le gɛh muh mu bɛŋ ba yuufe ncho bafɛɛ le wù besa wu chude blɛd a shu le.
Muh wù jee che le Mwamuh le wu gɛɛŋ gɛh no ba gɛ̀ saŋ kune wu. Geenɛ, ŋgɛ wù baaŋ le fɛ muh wù gesɛ muh wù jee che le Mwamuh. Fi be joŋe fɛ wuwɛɛ muh le lɛ keefɛ ba bôo wu gɛ.”

content: Jiso bɛ booŋ be ji ntɛ
No bo gɛ̀ jii mwɛɛ, Jiso ja wu jo blɛd, wu nya kiyone Nyo le, wu bweeyɛ, wu nya booŋ be ba ŋgoo le wu jɛmɛ lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ ko, finɛ le ye yaŋ.”

content: Wu mo wu jo tɛ fiŋkoo, wu nya kiyone Nyo le, wu mo wu nya fiŋkoo fiyu bo le, lɛ bo mu bo bachii.
Wu jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Finɛ le kilɛmɛ kaŋ kì Nyo gwo maŋkaŋ yu ki bu njɛ muh wù duude.
Nsɛŋe bɛŋ nchiɛɛŋ lɛ gɛ̀ mbaaŋ ŋka mu mbvuuŋ ma nchwɛŋ wu kite ki laane manɛ gɛ, gɛɛŋ bu juu chì nlé ŋgê mmû ma manfɛŋ antɛnɛɛ a bvunfoŋ bvu Nyo.”

content: Jiso bɛ booŋ be ba ŋgoo gɛ̀ mɛsɛ, bo yɛɛŋ ŋkee wu mbɛɛŋsɛ, bo mo bo bu bo bɛɛŋ bo gɛɛŋ yi Mbegɛ wu Bite bi Olif le.
Jiso jɛmɛ lɛ Bita lé wu gê wu fâŋ wu
Jiso gɛ̀ ja wu jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ bachii lé bɛŋ gê bɛŋ chîi bikaa a mɛ jiŋ. Le no ba le ba saŋ lɛ Nyo duu lɛ,
‘Nlé ŋgê n'yu nchiɛnɛ shóŋ, shóŋ saaŋɛ.’
Geenɛ, sege Nyo bvusɛ mɛ yi kwe le, nsa bɛŋ fwe Galalee.”

content: Bita chvuu Jiso le lɛ, “Nɛ bamii bachii chile bikaa a wo jiŋ, tu gɛ taŋlo nchii biaŋ gɛ.”
Jiso jɛmɛ wu le lɛ,

content.text: “Nsɛŋe wo nchiɛɛŋ lɛ kintaŋ ki abɛŋ kinɛ le, nyishii lé yi gê yi tôŋ kiŋgane kinfɛɛ, nyu wo faŋ wa mɛ kiŋgane kintɛde.”

content: Bita jɛmɛ fi tɛmɛ lo wu du lɛ, “Mo fi nyume lɛ nlé ŋkwê lo besa wo, tu gɛ taŋlo n'yu nfaŋ wo gɛ.” No wu jɛmɛ noo, bo bachii jɛmɛ gɛh tɛ noo.
Jiso buunɛ Gɛsɛmani
Bo gɛɛŋ bo lee fɛ mwɛ wu kitaŋ kimi le, ba tɛŋe lɛ Gɛsɛmani, Jiso jɛmɛ booŋ be ba ŋgoo le lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ shîi fɛnɛ, ŋgɛɛŋ mbuunɛ.”

content: Wu mo wu jo Bita bɛ Jɛm mo Joŋ, bɛ bo ja fo. Wu ja wu tu wu kwaji mwɛɛ wu nyume yi maluŋ le.
Wu jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Fitele fiaŋ le yii yii baaŋ njɛ ŋkwe lo. Bɛŋ shɛ̂ɛ fɛnɛ bɛŋ chîɛɛne.”

content: Jiso ja fo wu kɛŋsɛ wu gɛɛŋ fwe shige, wu gwe fɛkuu, wu buunɛ lɛ nɛ je be bee yu, kife ki ŋgɛ kinɛ ki fe lo.
Wu buunɛ lɛ,

content.text: “Aba, Chii, wo taŋlo wo ge fiɛɛ fichii. Wo chîaasɛ fiŋkoo fi ŋgɛ finɛ lɛ keefɛ mɛ mu gɛ. Geenɛ, gee gɛh no wo koŋe. Keefɛ wo gê no ŋkoŋe gɛ.”

content: Jiso kaasɛ wu tu jiŋ fɛ bo le, wu yɛŋ bo lefe. Wu biih Bita le lɛ,

content.text: “Samoŋ, wo lefe lo? Gɛ taŋlo wo chiɛɛŋ, gɛɛŋ bu yi ntaŋ wu kife le kimimia gɛ?
Bɛŋ nyûme we bɛŋ bûune lɛ keefɛ moŋ ge wu to fɛ bɛŋ le gɛ. Le nchiɛɛŋ lɛ fitele koŋe lo, geenɛ nyaŋ yi ye wɛɛyi.”

content: No wu jɛmɛ noo wu ka wu kaasɛ wu gɛɛŋ wu buunɛ gɛh no wu be buunɛ wa.
Wu doo wu kaasɛ wu tu jiŋ wu ka wu yɛŋ booŋ be ba ŋgoo lefe nje lefɛ gɛ̀ bee bo ajii baaŋ. Bo gɛ kɛɛ fiɛɛ fì bo chvuu wu le gɛ.
Wu kaasɛ wu tu jiŋ kiŋgane kintɛde, wu biih bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ baaŋ gɛh bɛŋ lefe bɛŋ fufe shɛŋ? Chi le chi kojɛ. Le wa kife. Ba le ba gesɛ wa muh wù jee che le Mwamuh bamii ba befe le.
Bɛŋ jâ we besabɛŋ gɛ̂ɛne. Bɛŋ jîŋɛ bɛŋ yɛ̂ŋ, nɛ muh wù gesɛ mɛ wunɛ, wu too wa.”

content: Ba koo Jiso

Gɛh no Jiso gɛ̀ baaŋ wu jɛme noo, kimimia Juda wù gɛ̀ bee muh ŋgoo yi booŋ ba Jiso ba yuufe ncho bafɛɛ le mo wu bunɛ. Wu gɛ̀ too bɛ kinchvu ki bamii bo kɛme nyó bɛ bimbuge, gɛ̀ tuŋ bachiji kintanyɛ ba baaŋ baaŋ bɛ bamii ba duunyi banchi mo bamii ba sage woŋ.
Gɛ̀ bee muh wù gɛ̀ gesɛ Jiso wu seesɛ wa njiŋɛ bɛ bamii bayu wu jɛmɛ lɛ, “Muh wù nlé ŋgê ŋkfugɛ nshiŋɛ, tu le wu, bɛŋ mo bɛŋ koo, bɛŋ jô bɛŋ gɛ̂ɛne bɛ wu bɛŋ jîiŋe lɛ keefɛ wu legɛ gɛ.”
No Juda to noo, wu mo wu gɛɛŋ lo fɛ Jiso le kimimia, wu yɛsɛ wu le lɛ, “Muh wu N'yɛyɛ.” No wu jɛmɛ noo, wu mo wu kfugɛ wu wu shiŋɛ.
Bamii baa mo bo koo Jiso, bo fajɛ wu le.
Muh mu wù gɛ̀ lɛme bɛ ba Jiso mo wu bvusɛ nyo yi jɛŋ, wu chuŋ kintuŋ ki nfwa wu kikwɛɛ ki bachiji kintanyɛ yu, ki suunɛ.
Jiso biih bamii bayu le lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ to ki bɛŋ kôo mɛ bɛŋ tu bɛŋ too bɛ nyó yi jɛŋ mo bimbuge njɛ bɛŋ too ki bɛŋ kôo nyûme chôŋ?
Nchi nshee lɛ juu lɛ juu nshiide fɛ yeh yi kintanyɛ le, n'yɛyi bamii jɛ yi Nyo fo fɛ bɛŋ koo mɛ sɛŋ nje la? Geenɛ, finɛ fichii jo kijusɛ ki fi to fi kojɛ no bamii ba ntuŋ wu Nyo gɛ̀ saŋ.”

content: Booŋ ba Jiso ba ŋgoo bachii mo bo noŋ wu fo, bo fɛɛ lo.
Chumu wumu bi wu le, wu baaŋ noŋ gɛ fiɛɛ ye le gɛ, wu buu gɛh nyu mwa nju ye le. Bo gɛɛŋ lɛ bo koo tɛ wu,
nju yiyu faanyɛ, wu chinɛ yu wu legɛ kichinɛ kiyɛsɛ.
Ba sa nsa wu Jiso
Bo mo bo jo Jiso, bo gɛɛŋ bɛ wu fɛ kikwɛɛ ki bachiji kintanyɛ le. Bachiji kintanyɛ ba baaŋ baaŋ bɛ bamii ba sage woŋ mo bamii ba duunyi banchi taashɛ fo.
Bo gɛ̀ gɛɛne bɛ Jiso, Bita bii lo ajiŋ je yì ndefe le. Wu gɛɛŋ wu bu fɛ lakfulɛ chi kikwɛɛ ki bachiji kintanyɛ le, wu shii bɛ bamii ba gɛ̀ chiɛɛne la chiyu bo tu bo yɛse ŋgu.
Bachiji kintanyɛ ba baaŋ baaŋ bɛ bamii bachii ba gɛ̀ sage bansa tu bo goone mwɛɛ mu bo kooyi yi Jiso le mu lé no mû ge ba yûuyɛ lo wu. Geenɛ, bo gɛ̀ baaŋ yɛŋ gɛ fiɛɛ le gɛ.
Bamii ba duude bɛɛ jiŋ yi nsa wu chimbiaŋ kune Jiso. Geenɛ, muh jɛme gɛ fiɛɛ fì too fi kooji bɛ fi muh mu gɛ.
Bamii bamu gɛ̀ ja bo lɛɛŋ we, bo chu chiboo chimbiaŋ ye ye le bo jɛmɛ lɛ,
“Bee chi be yu wu duu lɛ wu lé wu gê wu sâ yeh yi kintanyɛ yinɛ yì jonɛ muh wu wuŋ, wu jo aju atade, wu kaasɛ wu jooŋ yimi, jonɛ gɛ muh wu wuŋ gɛ.”
Mo no bo gɛ̀ jɛme noo, njɛmɛ wuboo too gɛ wù kooji gɛ.
Kikwɛɛ ki bachiji kintanyɛ mo ki ja ki lɛɛŋ we a bamii fwe, ki biih Jiso le lɛ, “Gɛ wo kɛme fiɛɛ fì wo chvuu gɛ? Wo yuge gɛ̀ mwɛɛ mù bamii banɛ kooyi ye yo le?”
Jiso mɛ gɛh jwe wuchile, wu gɛ chvuu fiɛɛ gɛ. Kikwɛɛ ki bachiji kintanyɛ ka ki biih Jiso le lɛ, “Le wo wu le Mbvusɛ wù Nyo gɛ̀ ka wu le Mwa Nyo, Nyo wù ba yuuse?”
Jiso chvuu lɛ,

content.text: “Le mɛ. Bɛŋ lé bɛŋ yɛ̂ŋ no muh wù jee che le Mwamuh shii a kibo kinchiɛɛŋ ki Muh wù Kɛme Bvuŋga, bɛŋ ka bɛŋ yɛŋ no wu too yi kimbɛ le fɛwe.”

content: Kikwɛɛ ki bachiji kintanyɛ yu noo, wu saayɛ njú ye,
wu biih lɛ, “Fiɛɛ baaŋ yu fì besabɛŋ ka be goone lɛ muh lɛɛŋ fɛnɛ wu jɛmɛ, lɛ la?
Gɛ bɛŋ yu no wu jode kijusɛ ki Nyo gɛ? Bɛŋ jɛme lɛ la?” Bamii bachii mo bo suunɛ lɛ wu le muh wu ba yuuyɛ lo.
Bamii bamu kɛ bo chuuyi nchwɛne yi Jiso le, bo kaaŋ ajii awe, bo tu bo kfuunyi wu bɛ muŋko, bo duu lɛ, “Gɛh gêe la muh wu ntuŋ wu Nyo kuŋ mɛɛse.” Bamii ba nchi gɛ̀ ja bo jo Jiso bo kɛ bo suŋe.
Bita faŋ Jiso
No Bita gɛ̀ bee je akuu akuu fɛ lakfulɛ, mwa wù kwɛse wu gɛ̀ lɛne fɛ la chi kikwɛɛ ki bachiji kintanyɛ le ja wu to mbebe ye le.
No wu yɛŋ Bita le wu yɛse ŋgu, wu bijɛ wu nɛ tuŋŋ, wu jɛmɛ lɛ, “Wo tɛ be bee bena Jiso muh wu Nasalɛ wege.”
Bita faŋ, wu jɛmɛ lɛ, “Gɛ ŋkee fiɛɛ fì wo jɛme finɛ gɛ. Gɛ ŋkee gɛ.” No wu jɛmɛ noo, wu mo wu ja fo wu gɛɛne fɛ jwe wu kitaŋ le, nyishii mo yi toŋ.
Mwa wù kwɛse wɛɛ ka wu yɛŋ wu le, wu jɛmɛ bamii ba gɛ̀ lɛme fo le lɛ, “Muh wunɛ le muh mu a bo ntɛnɛɛ.”
Bita ka wu faŋ. Kife gɛ̀ doo ki kɛŋsɛ shige, bamii ba gɛ̀ lɛme fo ka bo jɛmɛ Bita le lɛ, “Le nchiɛɛŋ lɛ wo le muh wuboo, nje wo le tɛ muh wu Galalee.”
Bita mo wu kaŋ, wu tɛɛŋ loŋ yi kikwɛɛ ke le wu jɛmɛ lɛ, “Gɛ ŋkee muh wunɛ wu bɛŋ jɛme kune wu gɛ.”
Kimimia nyishii mo yi toŋ kiŋgane kinfɛɛ. Wu mo wu kwajɛ njɛmɛ wù Jiso be jɛmɛ wu le lɛ,

content.text: “Nyishii lé yi gê yi tôŋ kiŋgane kinfɛɛ, a wo faŋ wa mɛ kiŋgane kintɛde.”

content: Wu mo wu kɛsɛ kwe wu tu wu beede.

footnotes.text: Fikaaŋ finɛ le ba gɛ̀ kɛnyi fi bɛ tɛdɛ chimi chì ba tɛŋe a jɛ yi bala le lɛ “alabasta”.
Wu gɛ̀ saayi nju ye noo, nje fi gɛ̀ saasɛ wu.
Gɛ baŋwa ba kege bamu kɛme jɛme wu le lɛ, “Nyishii mo yi toŋ” gɛ.
